audit.why: Milio wins levels 1-3 and 2+ items outright (Renata can't duel, poke/sustain wins step-ups); levels 4-5, 6 and first item are skill-based around dodging her E root and surviving her R berserk — matches content win[]/whys[].

Renata spikes with E Loyalty Program root (a pick tool) and R Hostile Takeover berserk (CD 150/130/110s); Milio's counter-spikes are first item (out-sustaining Bailout) and full items (R cleanses the berserk/root).
